homograph.note: The noun and adjective are /səˈbɔːdɪnət/ and the verb is /səˈbɔːdɪneɪt/, but the meanings stay transparently related, so this is a stress-and-vowel shift rather than a true homograph.

senses.definition: a person who has a lower rank than you and works under your authority

examples.en: A good manager listens to her subordinates before deciding.
examples.fa: مدیر خوب پیش از تصمیم‌گیری به حرف زیردستانش گوش می‌دهد.

senses.definition: less important than something else, or under the control of it

examples.en: In this plan, cost is subordinate to safety.
examples.fa: در این طرح، هزینه نسبت به ایمنی در درجه دوم است.

senses.definition: to treat one thing as less important than another and let the second one decide what you do

examples.en: They subordinated everything to the goal of winning the contract.
examples.fa: همه چیز را تابع هدفِ بردن قرارداد کردند.
